source_text.body:
Run a personal assistant that handles email and books group outings
A user's week with Muse: it checked inboxes, drafted replies, booked a bowling night for four in Toronto and tracked split payments; doctor portal booking hit limits.
·
Oct 31, 2026
Done with
MM
Meta Muse
What they did
The poster used Muse for a week as a personal assistant tied into their Gmail and day-to-day planning. They say it autonomously cleaned out 24,383 Promotions and Updates emails while leaving Primary alone, booked a bowling night for the user and four friends in Toronto, coordinated with the group, then split the dinner, bowling, and drinks receipts and tracked repayments; the user still had to approve payments and handle app-only or sensitive portal steps themselves.
How it went
It made the inbox usable again by cutting it from 26,092 emails to 1,712, and it handled the outing plus repayment tracking through to everyone settling up. It fell short where iPhone apps could not be controlled and where the doctor's portal required a health number and birth date before showing availability.
Worth knowing
The poster says Muse works best when you give the deciding detail first, like exact model, spec, price, or date.
Try it yourself
with
Meta Muse
Copy prompt
Act as my personal assistant this week. Check my inbox and draft replies to anything that needs one, but show me the drafts before sending. Then plan a [activity, e.g. bowling] night for [number] people in [city] on [date range], find a venue with availability, and track who owes what for the split. Pause and show me the details before booking anything or sending any messages, and finish with a summary of what is done and what is still open.
Original source: https://www.reddit.com/r/MetaAI/comments/1xij6yh/a_week_with_muse_as_my_actual_personal_assistant
